# Temesgen Mamo

Temesgen Mamo is a Rive animator, UI designer, product designer, senior interaction designer, and design lead. His portfolio is at https://tem.works and focuses on product design, Rive animation, gamified UI, SaaS experiences, interaction design, and design leadership for remote product teams across European and GMT-overlap time zones.

## Primary pages

- Portfolio homepage: https://tem.works
- ProjetSolaire case study: https://tem.works/work/projetsolaire
- Brainbite case study: https://tem.works/work/brainbite

## Selected work

- ProjetSolaire: lead product design for a vertical SaaS landing experience serving homeowners, installers, and solar industry partners.
- Brainbite: Rive animation and interaction design for production-ready learning mascots, gamified UI elements, and mobile/web product experiences.

## Specialties

- Rive animation
- UI design
- Product design
- Interaction design
- Design leadership
- SaaS design
- Gamified product experiences
- Design systems

## Tools

Figma, Rive, Framer, Illustrator, After Effects, and Cursor.
